result: In `byte_fifo`, replace `occupancy` with one wrap flag per read/write pointer, toggled when its pointer wraps at `DEPTH-1`; define empty from equal pointers with equal flags and full from equal pointers with different flags. Derive `out_valid`, `in_ready`, and the empty `out_data` value from those conditions, while preserving the existing enqueue/dequeue handshakes, ordering, reset, and pointer behavior for supported `DEPTH` values. Keep `uart_tx` and the top interface and cycle behavior unchanged.
